label: ORCID mandate begins (major publishers)
description: Elsevier, Springer Nature, Wiley, and others begin requiring ORCID for corresponding authors.

label: Crossref Funder Registry integration
description: Crossref promotes use of Open Funder Registry IDs alongside funder names in deposits.

label: Plan S announced
description: cOAlition S announces Plan S requiring immediate open access with CC licenses.

label: I4OC / Initiative for Open Citations
description: Major publishers join I4OC, committing to open reference deposits in Crossref.

label: ROR launch & adoption push
description: Research Organization Registry (ROR) launches, pushing for machine-readable affiliations.

label: Plan S enforcement begins
description: Plan S compliance requirements enforced. Journals must provide CC-BY licenses and full-text links.

label: CoARA agreement signed
description: Coalition for Advancing Research Assessment signed by 600+ organizations, calling for richer contributor metadata.

label: Crossref metadata quality initiative
description: Crossref launches Participation Reports, pushing members to improve abstract, reference, and funder deposits.

label: CRediT in JATS 1.4 & DORA/CoARA acceleration
description: CRediT taxonomy formally part of JATS 1.4. CoARA reform actions accelerate, but adoption remains minimal.
